Faceted bar chart of all 4 imputation quality metrics

Source: R/Imputation_Metrics.R
im_plot_metrics.Rd

Similar to nm_plot_metrics(): one facet per metric with free y-scales, labeled values on bars.

Usage

im_plot_metrics(metrics_df, ...)

Arguments

metrics_df

data.frame from im_compute_metrics().

...

Additional arguments (unused).

Value

ggplot object.

Examples

data(nadia_dia)
se <- im_prepare_se(nadia_dia, norm_method = "cycloess", verbose = FALSE)
metrics <- im_compute_metrics(se, methods = c("min", "zero", "knn"),
                              verbose = FALSE)
im_plot_metrics(metrics)
